ok reports check health. sent means HTTP success, not confirmed paging, recipient receipt or on-call acceptance. Webhook failure remains separate from health telemetry.
Final KV save and AE emission now occur after bounded webhook delivery. Existing five-second webhook timeout can delay their visibility; no latency/SLO improvement is claimed.

Retained diagnostics/webhook contents, historic telemetry, permitted schemas/access/retention and deployed destination/configuration require their existing privacy and operational work.
